asked.item: Why the blog image replaces my attached image on Facebook
How to keep my own image

verdict.reason: The Facebook FAQ explains that a link in the post makes Facebook show the link page's image, and it lists the steps to keep the attached image.

steps.text: When a Facebook post contains a link, Facebook generates a link preview card and uses the link page's own preview image (its featured image) instead of the image you attached.
This is Facebook's behavior, not Blotato's.
To keep your own image, open the post in Content Studio > Post editor and delete the link from the post text.
If you still want to share the URL, paste it as plain text in the caption instead of as a preview link.
Confirm your attached image is the one you want, then schedule or publish the post. With no link in the post, Facebook keeps the image you attached.
